intro_en: Arena-Hard-Auto v2.0 draws fresh real-world queries from Chatbot Arena, producing 500 difficult open-ended prompts and 250 creative-writing prompts. GPT-4.1 or Gemini-2.5 compares evaluated and baseline responses, and win-rate aggregation controls response length and Markdown style features.

drawio_review_note: The construction backbone is aligned with arXiv:2406.11939, while v2.0-specific details are aligned with the official LMArena repository because no separate v2.0 paper was found. The repository specifies two distinct Chatbot Arena sets: 500 fresh hard real-world queries and 250 creative-writing queries. The official hard-prompt configuration uses Gemini-2.5 as judge, with GPT-4.1 documented as an alternative; creative writing uses independently inferred GPT-4.1 and Gemini-2.5 judgments as an ensemble. Results are reported by category with bootstrap intervals, and the hard leaderboard controls Markdown and response-length features.
